description:
Trakt to Discord Rich Presence

Discrakt bridges your Trakt.tv watching status to Discord Rich Presence. It runs silently in your system tray and automatically updates your Discord status when watching movies or TV shows tracked by Trakt.tv.
Linux packages now run on older distributions
The 4.1.0 .deb, .rpm and AppImage packages were built against glibc 2.39 and refused to start on anything older than Ubuntu 24.04 (version GLIBC_2.39 not found). Linux packages are now built on Ubuntu 22.04, so they work on Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+ and RHEL 9+ equivalents.
v4.1.1 shipped without Linux packages because its build job failed; this release is the same code with the Linux assets included.
What's Changed
- ci: build cargo-deb from source on the Linux release runner by @afonsojramos in #320
Full Changelog: v4.1.1...v4.1.2
